newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, MCI in pact.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, MCI in pact.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said Monday it has an agreement with MCI Communications Corp to link their data transmission networks.

Bell Atlantic said the agreement to link the two companies' frame relay networks will allow it to market long-distance, non-voice services to its larger business customers throughout its six-state service area. MCI will carry the long-distance transmissions on Bell Atlantic's behalf.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Frame relay networks facilitate the exchange of packets of data over telephone lines.
Until now, Bell Atlantic could only market the local data transmission services it provides within each of its 19 local phone service areas, called local access transport areas.
